lane: independent structured verification / source only / zero product authorship
snapshot: Uncommitted DoctorTab, ListPatternTab, and showcase-tab store diff; source review may be superseded by concurrent builder edits.

A_live_outcome.basis: No build, browser session, field click, extraction, or real calendar rows were exercised in this lane. Earlier installed .97 evidence reproduced the blank handoff before the change and is baseline only.
A_live_outcome.required_check: On a fresh build and real repeating-card page, click the Doctor recommendation, confirm root/item selectors and nonempty suggested fields, select a meaningful field, Extract, and compare values with the page. Change page between probe and click, and between handoff and consumption; confirm rejection. Start ordinary Pick an example item and finish its field selection independently.

positive: Doctor passes the detected list_root and item_selector with tab ID and diagnostic URL through a one-shot shared store before selecting List Pattern.

List Pattern consumes the request, requires exact tab ID and URL, seeds empty field_paths, and its existing inspector effect can derive suggested fields from the seeded selectors. Extract remains disabled until a field is selected.
The original manual Pick an example item control and stamped picker-result handlers remain in place; the handoff does not invoke or replace them.

findings.classification: preexisting List Pattern state, unchanged by handoff patch
findings.reproduction: Seed or manually build a list config and preview rows, then navigate the same tab to another URL or switch active tabs without a new Doctor recommendation.
findings.finding: There is no general tab ID/URL invalidation of config, rows, source, candidates, or pending inspector/run results. The old builder stays visible and can Extract against or save under a new page context. The new handoff checks only its own incoming request and does not close this stale-state path.
findings.recommendation: Bind the builder and async inspector/run completions to a page key; on page change clear or visibly invalidate the prior config, preview, and candidates. Preserve ordinary manual picking on the current page.

findings.reproduction: Feed Doctor selectors that are nonempty strings but match no root/item on the target document; click the recommendation.
findings.finding: The handoff accepts string type alone. inspectCardInPage returns an empty list for missing selectors, while the builder can show a seeded config and the test only asserts selectors, Pick more fields, and disabled Extract. The source cannot establish that the detected repeating list produced selectable fields or extracted rows.
findings.recommendation: Treat zero matches or failed inspection as an honest unavailable state with re-probe/manual-pick remedy, and verify a field is selected and real row values are returned on the target page.

findings.classification: preexisting inspector behavior exposed by automatic handoff
findings.reproduction: Make inspector injection fail or return no candidates after a valid-looking handoff.
findings.finding: Failure is logged and converted to []; the suggested-field panel can say all fields are already selected even when none were selected. Manual Pick more fields remains available, but the empty state misstates what happened.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate inspection failure, zero candidates, and already-selected candidates, each with the appropriate visible remedy.

B_source_quality.test_limit: The new component test uses a manufactured diagnostic and mocked inspector returning []; it proves selector delivery and stale Doctor-click refusal, but never executes real field selection, inspector candidates, list extraction, or the ordinary manual picker. No test/build was run by this reviewer.

verification: Source only. No product changes, test/build/browser execution, commit, or push; reserved D22 checkpoint untouched.

source_recheck.scope: Same-reviewer bounded recheck of the three prior findings against revised uncommitted source; not a fresh independent review or live proof.

stale_builder_and_async_results.evidence: ListPatternTab now binds config to tab ID/URL, masks it immediately when the page key differs, clears config/rows/source/candidates/sample state on page change, and invalidates inspector and extraction sequence IDs. Inspector, sample-value, run, and sample-HTML completions check current page identity before committing. Picker results carry the page key from picker start, so delayed old-page results remain masked.

selector_matches_and_usable_fields.evidence: The handoff still accepts selector strings, then inspectCardInPage reports root_missing, items_missing, or ready with item count and candidates. The panel offers re-probe or manual pick on missing root/items, and a manual-pick or selector-edit remedy when a valid item has no suggested fields. Actual field selection and extracted values remain live checks.

inspector_failure_visibility.evidence: Inspector transport failure is now distinct from a successful empty inspection; CandidatesPanel displays a failure remedy. The 'all suggested fields selected' message appears only for ready inspection with zero unused candidates and a positive selected-field count.

source_recheck.verdicts: A remains live-unverified. B remains conditional until the real Doctor recommendation seeds fields that the user can select and extract, and the normal manual picker and stale-page paths are exercised in the installed extension.
